sourceStatement: The complete matching Temurin OpenJDK source archive and Adoptium build-script source are included in ../sources, with official build metadata and SBOM under upstream. They are redistributed with the binary in the same application archive, under GPLv2 with the Classpath Exception and included third-party licenses. Eclipse EPL components are unmodified; their exact upstream source references (including component path and commit) follow. Obtain corresponding source at those official repositories without a fee; use the specified commit, not current main. JDT LS root source and supplemental source JARs are included in ../sources. Native JDK/JVM sources are present in the complete OpenJDK source archive. Eclipse sources remain under their included EPL license; source availability does not change the license of unrelated Forkarak code. Complete original dependency legal files are preserved both within JARs and in jdtls-jars. Maven coordinate URLs below identify exact source artifacts. Some Eclipse-generated source reference URLs retain historical repository names; canonical JDT LS is eclipse-jdtls/eclipse.jdt.ls and JDT javac is eclipse-jdtls/eclipse.jdt.javac. The pinned distribution archives were obtained from official publishers; hashes were verified before staging. See NOTICE.md for component license choices and included source material.
